_comment: Shot list for a native-resolution recording (record.py, 2880x1800) of a made-up team task board. The same shape fits any app: hook, input, action, proof, close. 'target' and 'hide' are pixels in the recording: read them off a grid frame from review.py grid. Zoom stays at or below recording width / output width (2880/1920 = 1.5) so nothing is upscaled. For a Cursorful export the zooms are already in the picture: leave out target and zoom.

shots.caption: One board for the whole team
shots.say: This is the task board your whole team works from.

shots.caption: Add a task in one line
shots.say: You type what needs doing, and press Enter.

shots.caption: It sorts itself
shots.say: The board files it under the right project for you.

shots.caption: Drag it to who owns it
shots.say: Drag the card to a teammate, and they are told straight away.

shots.caption: Everyone sees the same plan
shots.say: Now everyone sees the same plan, on any device.
